description.value: Villages Pizza is a regional pizza chain with deep roots in Victoria's neighbourhoods, operating under Sanderson & Louis Holdings. The Oak Bay Avenue location sits in a walkable, bikeable commercial strip and offers both delivery and in-store pickup. The chain supports school lunch programs and community catering, making it a practical stop for groups or solo touring cyclists passing through Oak Bay.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 8m; rack (2 spaces) at 27m; rack (2 spaces) at 40m; rack (2 spaces) at 57m; rack (covered) at 68m; rack (2 spaces) at 70m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags confirm this is a pizza fast-food location at 2016 Oak Bay Avenue, Victoria, with a listed phone and website. The website is active and corroborates the business name and general Victoria presence; the /contact page lists 'Oak Bay / Gordon Head' as a location option, consistent with the OSM address. The /catering page explicitly mentions 'vegetarian options,' 'lactose free cheese,' and 'gluten conscious crusts,' confirming dietary accommodations; the /order page confirms delivery and pick-up (takeout). No evidence on the website addresses bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: Website front page and some subpages display 'We can't find the internet / Something went wrong' JavaScript error banners, suggesting a client-side rendering issue during fetch; enough static content was recovered from subpages to confirm the business is operational.
Phone number from OSM (+1 250 598-3623) could not be directly verified against website content as no per-location phone numbers were visible in the fetched pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza restaurant in a bikeable Victoria neighbourhood; website is live and confirms ongoing operations including online ordering and catering.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Catering page lists 'vegetarian options,' 'lactose free cheese,' and 'gluten conscious crusts.'
